title: Hoots' Hooch
summary: Drink one dose for a random wild-magic effect. Purity of Body blocks the effects.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. One of ten outcomes is chosen at random. Monk Purity of Body prevents the effects.
fields.Beast Tongue · 20 turns: Disadvantage on Charisma and Animal Handling checks against Beasts.
fields.Blackout · 5 turns: Unconscious. The drinker wakes in Wyrm’s Rock Prison.
fields.Blink · 10 turns: Shift between the Material and Ethereal planes.
fields.Dancing Fool · 2 turns: Cannot move or act. Disadvantage on attacks and Dexterity saves. Attackers gain advantage.
fields.Gifted · 20 turns: Read minds but become vulnerable to Psychic.
fields.Photosensitivity · 10 turns: Gain Superior Darkvision but become Blinded in direct sunlight.
fields.Size Instability · 10 turns: Alternate Reduced and Enlarged every turn.
fields.Stoned · 2 turns: Petrified, then gain Stoneskin for 10 turns.
fields.Acquisition: Buy or receive it from Hoots Hooligan at Sharess’ Caress.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
